args.title: trips_raw stalled, collapsing agg_daily_rides volume
args.description_markdown:
Confirmed chain: `raw.trips_raw` → `staging.stg_trips` → `marts.fct_trips` → `marts.agg_daily_rides`.

`trips_raw` is a confirmed source and is 26.02 hours stale against a 6-hour SLA. Downstream, `stg_trips` and `fct_trips` each fell to 3,120 rows from 1,281,900, and `agg_daily_rides` fell to 4 rows from 182; its assertion expected 25..400. No data was modified. A human must restore the trips ingestion, rerun the dependent pipeline, and validate the assertions.

One-hop upstream lineage was empty and confirm_no_upstreams returned confirmed, proving a source-level intrinsic freshness breach.

postmortem.title: Trips source freshness breach collapsed downstream ride counts
postmortem.symptom: agg_daily_rides row-count assertion failed: 4 rows observed versus 25..400 expected; previous count 182 (-97.8%).
postmortem.root_cause_summary: trips_raw was 26.02h stale against a 6h SLA. Its 1,284,500 rows and required schema including pickup_ts remained intact. Empty one-hop lineage and confirm_no_upstreams=confirmed establish an intrinsic source ingestion freshness breach with no unhealthy parent.

causal_path.name: agg_daily_rides
evidence: Assertion observed 4 rows versus expected 25..400.
Row count fell from 182 to 4 (-97.8%).
Freshness remained healthy at 1.21h versus 6h SLA.

causal_path.name: fct_trips
evidence: Assertion observed 3,120 rows versus expected 50,000..2,000,000.
Row count fell from 1,281,900 to 3,120 (-99.76%).
Freshness was 1.21h versus 6h SLA; schema was healthy.

causal_path.name: stg_trips
evidence: Assertion observed 3,120 rows versus expected 50,000..2,500,000.
Row count fell from 1,281,900 to 3,120 (-99.76%).
Freshness was 25.02h versus 6h SLA; schema including pickup_ts was healthy.

causal_path.name: trips_raw
evidence: Freshness was 26.02h versus 6h SLA, 20.02h beyond SLA.
Row count was stable at 1,284,500; required schema including pickup_ts was present.
One-hop upstream lineage was empty and confirm_no_upstreams returned confirmed.
Run ID: run_93130e4fb6f84e58.
Healthy sibling branch excluded: stg_zones and zones_raw each had 265 rows, healthy schema, and freshness within the 168h SLA; zones_raw was confirmed as a source.
pickup_ts on trips_raw was tagged oncall_root_cause; seven downstream datasets were tagged oncall_impacted; owners were notified.
Active DataHub incident: urn:li:incident:oncall-b4b3a0fa025b93c7cb83b8799547adc7.
postmortem.recommended_action: Restore raw trips ingestion, then rerun stg_trips -> fct_trips -> all downstream aggregates and features. Validate trips_raw freshness and downstream row-count assertions before declaring recovery.
postmortem.prevention: Add a paging freshness monitor at the 6h SLA and an ingestion heartbeat with runbook for trips_raw; add a publish circuit breaker that blocks stg_trips and downstream assets whenever trips_raw breaches its freshness SLA.

text: `agg_daily_rides` collapsed to 4 rows versus 182 previously, failing its 25–400 assertion. Root cause: `trips_raw` is 26.02 hours stale against a 6-hour SLA, propagating through `stg_trips` and `fct_trips`. The authoritative blast radius is **15 affected assets**, led by Exec Daily Ops, `fct_trips`, and Rides by Hour. Incident `oncall-b4b3a0fa025b93c7cb83b8799547adc7` remains in INVESTIGATION; owners were notified and evidence preserved. A human must restore trips ingestion, rerun downstream pipelines, and verify freshness and row-count assertions.
